_comment: School counselor pages and local aggregators for Palm Beach and Broward.
This is the seed set that replaces hand-verifying BMF organizations: counselors
list only awards their students can actually apply to, with current deadlines,
so the verification is already done.
Two things learned building it. Palm Beach Google Sites is a THIN vein -- after
~10 query formulations only Jupiter and Wellington are true bulletins; the rest
are counseling hubs that merely link onward. And Broward has NO school-level
bulletins off browardschools.com, which is robots-blocked, so the Broward
substitute is the Education Foundation's searchable award database.
SouthTech Academy is the richest new target: a numbered PDF bulletin series in
structured NAME | AWARD | DEADLINE tables. PDF support was added to the crawler
for these -- without it a PDF decodes to garbage and reads as 'thin'.

seeds.note: Structured table: scholarship name, award, deadline. Boynton Beach charter serving all of Palm Beach County.
Index page -- should enumerate the current year's bulletin set so the series can be followed forward.
